title: Niwashi Plan Profile v1
description: Schema for the nws.profile/v1 YAML file, used with 'nwsctl plan --profile'.

version.description: The schema version for the profile file.

name.description: A unique name for the profile.

capabilityBinding.description: Specifies the FQID of a recipe to use for a given capability to resolve ambiguity.

params.description: Parameters to be merged into the target state.

cluster.description: Parameters applied to a specific cluster, keyed by the cluster ID.

capability.description: Parameters applied to all resources that have the specified capability.
